_comment: Default theme palette - the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for brand colours.
These are Philly Phone Repair's values. A deployment overrides them with
import). The same defaults are mirrored as a TypeScript constant in
contracts/brand.ts, because that module is also bundled for the BROWSER,
where both ways of reading this file fail: `createRequire` is a Node
builtin that Vite externalizes, and a `.cjs` module is evaluated by Vite's
SSR loader with no `module` binding. api/brand-colors.test.ts asserts the
two copies stay identical, so drift cannot go unnoticed.
